title: Consolidated Ticket Controls
summary: Ticket commands are cleaner and explicitly added support members can now reply to customers.
added: A claimant-only /ticket control command with customer, support, and close actions.
A consolidated /ticket admin command with assignment, removal, punishment, close, and undo actions.
Remove Support actions for both ticket claimants and administrators.
changed: Support members added to a ticket can now use /reply without replacing the original claimant.
Legacy explicit support permissions remain recognized for existing open tickets.
Former standalone ticket-management commands are consolidated under /ticket.
